_readme: Maps each SIMULATED region (the names used by gen_cluster.py) to real-world data sources.
watttime_region : WattTime region code (null = no live carbon, use carbon_fallback). Find codes with: python3 watttime_client.py --my-access
carbon_fallback: g CO2/kWh used when there is no live value. The numbers below are SYNTHETIC placeholders.
aqueduct       : {country, province} to look up with build_water_table.py (null = keep the scarcity values written here).
scarcity_site / scarcity_grid: Aqueduct baseline water stress SCORE, 0 (low) to 5 (extremely high). Placeholders until the lookup runs.

real-california.label: REAL: Northern California (WattTime CAISO_NORTH + Aqueduct California)
